text:
noah: Starting a phased rollout for redwood-v2.2.0 in ~10m. Order US -> EU -> APAC. Canary 5%, 10m pin per region.

mina: Running capacity & warmpool checks now. Will post numbers in 3.

ops-sre: Preflight: US free GPUs 88/110 (80%); EU 60/80 (75%); APAC 18/40 (45%). APAC below threshold.

noah: If APAC <60% we'll either warm pool or start APAC at 1% canary. Proceeding with US now.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled release=redwood-v2.2.0 regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=0.05 pin=10m. Use `/deploy status 1742468100`.

deploy-bot: US canary s-301 started.

carmen: US p95 stable, errors normal. US pinned 10m and green.

deploy-bot: EU canary s-302 started.

mina: EU looks clean. Meanwhile warmpool +3 requested for APAC.

ops-sre: APAC warmup complete: new free GPUs 26/43 (60%). Exactly at threshold. Recommend APAC canary 3% to be conservative.

noah: Update rollout: APAC canary=3% instead of 5%. `/deploy update 1742468100 --region apac --canary 0.03`

deploy-bot: APAC canary s-303 started.

deploy-bot: :warning: s-303 reports `kv_cache_miss_rate` spike at +4m (0.9%).

mina: Logs show repeated shard routing errors on host apac-ff-2. Rolling back APAC canary. `/deploy rollback --slice s-303 --reason "shard routing errors"`

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for s-303. APAC pin released.

noah: Action items: ops-sre to isolate apac-ff-2 and run config-sync; mina to run staging repro; we'll hold APAC and keep US/EU live. Open incident INC-2026-151.

carmen: Noted. Posting follow-up links in the incident.
